Papua New Guinea
Consular help: Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Canberra, Australia.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport YES Visa shall be issued in Australia.
Regular biometric passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport YES
Diplomatic biometric passport YES
Citizens of the Papua New Guinea are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina. Visa shall be issued in Canberra, Australia.
